label: D1: high after reaching S1, low after S2; GO: high after a2, lower after reward.
short_terms: (phase == D1) * ((prev_state == S1) * 1 - (prev_state == S2)) ;; (phase == GO) * ((prev_action == 2) * 1 - (prev_reward == 1)) ;; (phase == GO) * belief_lo
terms: (phase == D1) * (prev_state == S1) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == S2) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 1) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_action == 2) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_action == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 1) * (prev_state==S1) ;; (phase == GO) * belief_lo ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward==1) * (prev_common==1)
explanation: Raw reset gate r of unit 17 (timing alone R^2 0.64; D2 near saturation ~0.95 and barely modulated). At D1 its magnitude tracks the state reached on the previous trial: about +0.24 above timing after S1, -0.24 after S2 (reward adds only a little, slightly more after S1-rewarded). At GO it is raised when the previous choice was a2 (+0.25) and lowered when the previous trial was rewarded (-0.19), so it is lowest after a1-rewarded and highest after a2-unrewarded. The free fit adds a separate S1/S2 offset at D1, an S1-rewarded bump at D1, an extra drop at GO after common-rewarded trials, and a small negative GO dependence on the observer belief log-odds (dev 0.75 vs 0.70 short). Belief alone is weaker (reference 0.23) than last-trial cues (0.75); future variables are not needed.

issues: Each claim checks out on test. Dropping the S2 half of the D1 contrast lowers R^2 from 0.69 to 0.50, so the signed S1-minus-S2 contrast is needed. The fitted weights match the explanation: D1 +0.239 for the S1/S2 contrast, GO +0.248 after a2, GO -0.194 after a reward.

Misses on the recorded short form show no large systematic error. The worst cells are about 0.13: GO after a2 S1 r is over-predicted by 0.13, GO after the first trial ('?') is under-predicted by 0.12, and D1 after a1 S*u is over-predicted by about 0.09.

D1 also has smaller a2 and reward effects that the short form and label leave out. For example, D1 after a2 S1 r is +0.32 against +0.16 after a1 S1 u (profile residual table). These effects are modest.

The recorded form leaves part of the GO signal unexplained. The GO residual falls steadily with belief, from +0.16 in belief decile 0 to -0.18 in decile 9. Merging the a2 and reward effects into one contrast frees a term for (phase==GO)*belief_lo, and test R^2 beyond timing rises from 0.692 to 0.735 (free fit 0.746). The merged contrast alone, with no belief term, gives 0.696. Using belief at GO but dropping reward gives 0.628, so reward is still needed. Clipping belief_lo gives 0.735, the same score, so the gain does not come from outliers.
